_meta.description: Closed set of -ственный/-твенный quality adjectives whose masculine short form has two competing endings (Rozental §160): a contracted '-ен' ending (свойствен) that is the modern prescriptive norm, and an uncontracted '-енен' ending (свойственен) that reads as a heavier/marked, slightly archaic variant. Keyed by the full adjective lemma; 'norm' and 'marked' are the masc-sing short-form surfaces. Cross-checked against pymorphy3: the 'norm'/'marked' pair corresponds to pymorphy's own dictionary paradigm split on the internal 'V-en' grammeme (present on the '-енен' member of the pair) for every entry except 'бессмысленный', where 'бессмысленен' is not itself a dictionary headword but is recognized by pymorphy's suffix-heuristic analyzer with a matching ADJS/masc/sing profile.
_meta.source: manual curation; Rozental grammar tradition (§160 short-form adjective variants); pymorphy3 V-en cross-check
